description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework with type‑safe routing, built‑in security, and plug‑and‑play middleware – the Express alternative that scales to millions of requests per second.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 shift to edge‑computing and AI‑ready services: native ESM, zero‑dependency core, TypeScript‑first API, built‑in request validation and rate‑limiting, plus automatic OpenAPI generation. Benchmarked at >2 M rps on a single VM, it outperforms Express and Fastify while keeping the bundle footprint < 10 KB. Daily‑release (v0.0.124‑daily.20260905) shows transparent, rapid iteration that appeals to early adopters and CI pipelines.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese for its zero‑dependency core – no hidden packages, no bloat, instant install.
Performance: >2 M requests/second, sub‑1 ms latency on V8, and built‑in HTTP/2 & TLS optimizations beat Express/Fastify out of the gate.
Developer experience: Type‑safe routing, auto‑generated OpenAPI docs, one‑line security middleware, and hot‑reload friendly daily builds make prototyping and production scaling painless.
